predicate_semantics.scalar_and_lanes: Radius and iteration predicate evaluated at state iteration 0,1,...,50 before a whole next-state commit; eight-lane early termination occurs when every lane is outside.
predicate_semantics.five: Radius and iteration predicate evaluated at state iteration 0,5,...,50 before a five-recurrence whole next-state commit. Intermediate four predicates are intentionally unobserved, matching frozen fast authored source.

per_step_reference: Independent scalar-coordinate arithmetic and explicit per-step group recurrence, with no FMA; full PBM packing implemented in Python.
five_step_reference: Independent explicit eight-lane state recurrence, five advances between observations, including lane tails.
